Spawned by TKT-73 / ADR-025 (admission lifecycle events and offline reconciliation). The ADR's decision statements are binding constraints on this ticket.

description: Implement ADR-025 §D6/9/10: every duplicate_admit owes a durable admission-conflict alarm — a NEW operational alarm class, transactionally committed with the append (outbox pattern per access's lifecycle_integrity_alarm_outbox), deliberately separate from ADR-021 integrity alarms (the chain is valid; the world disagreed). Own schema-1 contract, ADR-017 governs evolution. Bounded identifiers and enums only — no PII (ADR-003 §D3). GATE-3 REVIEW ADDITION: derived pass-policy conflicts are alarmed as revisable (an alarm can be withdrawn, an appended event cannot — ADR-025 §D2).
